collision.method: independent original URDF collision geometry; source adjacent/fixed-link exemptions only

registry.duplicate_definition: same scene factors AND actual root/DOF initial state; old stochastic physical resets differ from declared nominal kinematic state

geometry.reach_bound_formula: sum(norm(arm joint origin translations)) + norm(TCP offset); necessary geometric bound, not IK proof

registry.label: KINEMATIC_RENDERED_REFERENCE
registry.language_order: fixed proposal index modulo 3 colors; (index+command)%2 template; VAL templates2/3

renderer.envelope_population: all remaining proposals including UNUSED_RESERVED plus OLD calibration; no TEST geometry queries

solver.failed_interval: stop; retain accepted prefix and every attempt
solver.joint_candidates: project into original hard bounds; no random restarts

reset.root_DOF_generator: actual pinned defaults and native random reset; exact seed registered, actual bytes retained before first physics
reset.target_axis_orientation: source reference R0 is measured reset FK; cue axes use that same R0 @ original yaw, bound once before first physics; camera unchanged
reset.task_anchor: measured reset FK; reference formula fixed before outcomes; no robot teleport
